Messages.Body:
On VTES-L, James Coupe writes:
> In message <909778678...@oracle.wizards.com>, Automatic digest
> processor <LIST...@ORACLE.WIZARDS.COM> writes
> >You're right - you can use Shepherd's Innocence (sup) to move animalism
> >retainers you control around. [LSJ 25-NOV-97]
>
> I thought there was a standing rule that if you gain control of
> something that you already control (eg Disputing a Tomb to yourself) you
> do not get to place it on something new, and that it has to go via
> someone else first.

Yes. But Shepherd's Innocence has explicit card text:
"Take control of all cards in play that require Animalism. You may put
the equipment and retainer cards on any vampires you control."

--
